description: Save, find and organise bookmarks and tags on linkhut - add, update, read and delete bookmarks, page through all of them, check what changed, count them per day, get tag suggestions and rename or delete tags.

api.description: Save a new bookmark; fails when the url is already saved. With `replace: 'yes'`, rewrite the saved bookmark for the url instead (omitted fields are cleared)

fields.description: The bookmark URL.
The bookmark title.
Notes for the bookmark.
Sent comma delimited, as the API asks. A post in a response lists its tags space delimited.
The creation time to record for the bookmark.

'yes' updates the bookmark already saved for this url and fails when there is none; every field is rewritten, so an omitted `extended` or `tags` becomes empty, `shared` becomes yes and `toread` no, and `dt` is ignored. Omitted or 'no', a new bookmark is created and the call fails when the url is already saved.
'no' makes the bookmark private. Omitted counts as 'yes' (public).
'yes' marks the bookmark as unread. Omitted counts as 'no'.

api.description: List bookmarks by offset, up to 1000 per page. Follow `nextStart` until it is null

fields.description: Only posts with this tag.
Offset of the first post to return. Omitted counts as 0.
Page size. The API allows up to 100000 and answers 1000 when this is omitted, so 1000 is sent whenever it is unset.
Only posts saved at this time or later.
Only posts saved at this time or earlier.
Set to 'yes' to add the change-detection signature to each post.

fields.type: { description: string, extended: string, hash: string, href: string, meta?: string | null, others?: number | null, shared: yes | no, tags: string, time: string, toread: yes | no }[]

fields.description: The offset this page was read from.
The page size that was requested.
Offset of the next page while this one is full; null on the last page.

api.description: List every bookmark as a URL MD5 and a change signature, to find what changed without downloading all bookmarks

fields.description: One entry per bookmark, newest first.

api.description: Count the bookmarks saved on each day

fields.description: Only count posts with this tag.
Number of posts saved per day, UTC.

api.description: Delete the bookmark for a url. This cannot be undone

fields.description: The URL of the bookmark to delete.

api.description: Get the bookmarks of one day, the bookmarks with a tag, the bookmark for a url (empty when it is not saved) or the bookmarks for URL MD5 hashes

fields.description: One tag, or several separated by spaces or commas. Without `dt`, `url` or `hashes`, a tag searches every day.
The day to list, CCYY-MM-DD (a full CCYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ time is cut to its day; linkhut reads only a day). With no argument at all, the most recent day that has a bookmark.
The one bookmark to look up.
URL MD5 values. Several are joined with a space on the wire, which is what the `+` in the docs decodes to.
Set to 'yes' to add the change-detection signature to each post.

fields.type: { description: string, extended: string, hash: string, href: string, meta?: string | null, others?: number | null, shared: yes | no, tags: string, time: string, toread: yes | no }[]
fields.description: The posts of one day.

api.description: Get the time of the last bookmark change, to tell whether posts.all needs to be read again

fields.description: Time of the last bookmark added or changed, UTC. 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z for an account with no bookmarks.

api.description: List the most recent bookmarks, up to 100, optionally with one tag. There is no offset

fields.description: Only posts with this tag.
How many posts to return. Default 15, maximum 100. Omitted, no count is sent and the default applies.

fields.type: { description: string, extended: string, hash: string, href: string, meta?: string | null, others?: number | null, shared: yes | no, tags: string, time: string, toread: yes | no }[]
fields.description: The most recent posts. There is no offset, so this is the first page only.

api.description: Get popular and recommended tags for a url

fields.description: The URL to suggest tags for.
Tags many bookmarks share.
Tags linkhut recommends.

api.description: Delete a tag from every bookmark. The bookmarks stay, and the tag cannot be restored

fields.description: The tag to delete from every bookmark.

api.description: List every tag with the number of bookmarks that carry it
Rename a tag on every bookmark that carries it

fields.description: The tag to rename.
The name it takes on every bookmark.
